put.description: Replace the signed-in user's first name, last name and email. The signature is uploaded through its own endpoint.
Replace the signed-in user's password. The current password must be given and correct; newPassword must be 8+ characters and match confirmPassword.
Upload a signature image (jpeg/png/webp, checked by magic bytes, ≤ 10MB) for the signed-in user. Replaces any existing signature. Printed on every receipt this user exports.

delete.description: Clear the signed-in user's signature and remove the underlying file (best-effort)

get.description:
Get bills (paginated) — id, type, storeId, storeName, bookNo,
receiptNo, customerName, customerAddress, total, itemCount, hasSlip, createdAt

parameters.description: filter by bill type: receipt or payment
parameters.name: type

post.description:
Create a bill (JSON) with one or more line items, priced by the
caller (no price list). Book/receipt numbers are computed
server-side, scoped per (store, type); unit/subtotal/total and
anything else derivable are ignored if the client sends them.
createdAt is optional (RFC3339) to back-/post-date the bill —
defaults to now when omitted; never affects book/receipt numbering.

get.description: Get bill by id — every bills column except deleted_at, plus a ready-to-use slipUrl

put.description:
Replace a bill's customer, items, discount, and shipping fee
(JSON, same shape as create). storeId and type must match the
existing bill — sending different values is rejected with 400.
Book/receipt numbers and the slip are never touched here.

delete.description: Delete bill by id — soft delete only, slip and book/receipt number are kept as-is (never reused)

put.description: Upload a slip image (jpeg/png/webp, checked by magic bytes, ≤ 10MB) for an existing, non-deleted bill. Replaces any existing slip.

delete.description: Clear a bill's slip and remove the underlying file (best-effort)

post.description: Create a new customer by name

get.description: Get every address on file for this customer

post.description: Add a new address for a customer, optionally marking it default

get.description: Get every phone number on file for this customer (default-first)

post.description: Add a new phone number for a customer, optionally marking it default

get.description:
Stream a file previously uploaded via POST/PUT /bills (e.g. a
payment slip) by its storage key, such as bills/slips/<uuid>.jpeg

put.description: Replace a store's name, address, and phone. The logo is uploaded through its own endpoint.
Upload a logo image (jpeg/png/webp, checked by magic bytes, ≤ 10MB) for an existing store. Replaces any existing logo.

delete.description: Clear a store's logo and remove the underlying file (best-effort)

get.description: Get, for every product, the price used in this store's most recent bill of the given type — used to prefill the create-bill form (optional).

createdAt.description:
CreatedAt lets the client back- or post-date a bill (e.g. entering one
for a sale that actually happened earlier) — RFC3339, e.g.
"2026-09-20T14:30:00+07:00". Optional; defaults to the time the
request is processed when omitted. Only book/receipt numbering's
calendar-year rollover uses the real server clock — this field never
affects that.

createdBy.description:
Audit fields — each is JSON null (never omitted, never a zero
time) when unknown: createdBy for bills from before it was
recorded, editedAt when never edited via PUT /bills/:id,
slipUploadedAt when there's no slip.

signature.description:
Ready-to-use URL of the user's signature image — printed on every
receipt they export. Empty string when unset.
